count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints label 24 twice (T/F q024, q024b) and 27 twice (match q027, one-mark q027b); 51 questions. Answer side: T/F 18-26 (q024b unkeyed), the match block labelled '26.' (= q027), one-mark 27-34 (27 = q027b), 35-49 — all by printed number. Difficulty per question: easy 36, average 9, difficult 6, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 76 (heading, LO, q1-3) 77-79; A pdf 173 (heading) 174-175.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-17; s3 T/F q18-26 (incl. q024b); s4 '27. Match the following with suitable answers (easy)' q027; s5 one mark q027b-q34 vsa; s6 two marks q35-39 sa; s7 three marks q40-44 sa; s8 four marks q45-49 la.

KEY SIDE ANALYSED FIRST: no displaced band. Repeated labels -> q024b, q027b (v1.4 §14.1). q024b has no printed key (nine T/F keys for ten questions; keys 25/26 fit q025/q026). The match key is labelled '26.' -> 'numbering label misprint'. Key 27 restates nothing and fits q027b ('Competitions like singing, drawing, and drama are held.').

q049 prints its tag cut at the line end '(Diff' (pdf 79, before the Lesson 19 heading) -> difficulty 'difficult', difficulty_as_printed 'Diff' (only one level begins 'Diff'); the fragment removed from text, kept in text_as_printed.
Keys 40-49 are wrapped prose (joined). q2 option row is glued in the text layer ('C) TalkD) Experience') -> options split as printed on the page. LO 4 bullets.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_18.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
